# GeoKnight GIS
> GeoKnight GIS (GeoKnight Geospatial Information Services), based in Jacksonville, Florida and serving clients anywhere, builds custom GIS web applications: interactive web maps, dashboards and map-based tools for businesses and government. Pricing: $95–$125/hr; Starter map $350; custom dashboard or tool $1,500–$5,000; data pipelines / integrations from $5,000; custom quotes by call. Managed hosting from $150/mo (Basic), $400/mo (Standard), $1,000/mo (Premium), including cloud costs up to $50/$150/$400 per month; usage above the allowance billed at cost plus a small margin; setup from $500. Founded by Christopher Knight, GIS & Data Engineer.
